priority_status: Bounded literature search found no equivalent result for this exact model; this is not exhaustive priority clearance. Steinsky 2003 remains unread in full.
proof_scope: Logarithmic asymptotic through the n^(1/3) Airy term, its Lambert-W threshold displacement, and every fixed c>=2. No ratio equivalent, prefactor, amplitude, final O(log n) remainder, all-orders expansion, or growing-c uniformity.
attribution: Exact DAG enumeration, generalized parking-function identities, and homogeneous Airy estimates are established prior inputs. The report applies them with a reciprocal-potential transfer.
bundled_source_policy: No journal full-text files, full OEIS entry text, unpublished working notes, review records, or unrelated files are bundled.
